parsed.rationale: The subtask requires fetching payment card information for employees in the Human Resources department. Candidate 8 provides all company employees' information, which can be filtered by department_name to identify HR employees. Then, their IDs can be used to fetch payment card info. This API is broad but necessary to identify HR employees first, as no API directly fetches payment cards by department.
